queries.result: First-party discovery found the Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources announcement for real-estate registration information and cadastral-map visualization, plus the official Beijing Tianditu public geospatial service portal. The announced registry query requires identity verification for visual real-estate lookup; no anonymous safe parcel feature response was verified.

queries.result: First-party Chinese discovery found the official Chinese announcement describing Beijing's cadastral-map and parcel-map query modules and the official Beijing Tianditu service portal. The announcement states that cadastral/parcel lookup is available through the Beijing real-estate registration platform, while owner-oriented access is handled at district registration halls; no anonymous Changping parcel geometry or schema was verified.

registryBasis: The official Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources identifies the municipal real-estate registration platform and its cadastral-map/parcel-map query modules. This is a first-party registry/cadastre custodian and procedure, but not evidence of an open Changping parcel feature API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official notices describe Beijing-wide cadastral and sub-cadastral map query and parcel-map query modules, with real-estate registration information for registered properties; they do not establish an openly downloadable, citywide Changping parcel layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official policy and service pages were fetched. The registry entry point and HTTPS route both timed out in bounded anonymous requests; Beijing Tianditu service resources were fetched, but no parcel layer, public feature endpoint, schema, CRS, or native parcel ID was verified.

technicalBlocker: Bounded anonymous GET requests to http://bdc.ghzrzyw.beijing.gov.cn/eo/wizard/mainMenu.go and https://bdc.ghzrzyw.beijing.gov.cn/eo/wizard/mainMenu.go timed out after 25 and 20 seconds respectively. The official policy says visual real-estate/cadastral lookup uses identity verification; no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS weakening was used. The official Beijing Tianditu service page returned HTML, but its listed public resources did not expose a verified parcel feature request or safe ID-plus-geometry response.
remainingUncertainty: The current registry application's JavaScript/configuration, exact access policy for Changping, schema, CRS, native identity field, and parcel coverage remain unknown. Timeout, authorization requirements, and lack of an exact-point hit are not evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later serial reviewer may qualify an anonymous first-party parcel endpoint only after independently verifying schema, CRS, stable native identity, and safe ID-plus-geometry output.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
